# Agent Blueprint

> Know what every AI agent will cost and save, before you build it.

Agent Blueprint® is software as a service (https://app.agentblueprint.ai) that turns a profile of a business into a ranked list of the AI agents worth building, each with a design and a business case. It is made by Agent Blueprint, Inc. Access is by request; self-serve signup is closed.

## What the software does

1. Profile: the business, the systems it runs and what it's aiming for.
2. Ranked use cases: the agents worth building, rated for value and complexity, with a forced ranking so only one or two come out as high priority.
3. Agent design and business case: for each use case the customer picks, the agents, the tools they use, their guardrails and where a person approves. Cost, savings and payback are calculated in code; every figure is labelled with its source and confidence, and inputs can be changed.
4. Export: each design exports as Agent Skills files and through an MCP server, so coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor can build it on the platform the customer runs.

## Words used on this site

- Agent Blueprint: the name of the software. A registered trademark of Christopher Faulkner (U.S. Reg. No. 8,407,180).
- Agent record: the one-page record of one agent, a short summary plus seven sections (purpose, authority, proof, owner, cost, promise, result).
- Agent design: the design of an agent or agent team inside the software.
- Starter records: free, reusable agent records for common kinds of agent, such as IT ticket triage.

## Who uses it

- Companies planning AI agents: request access at https://agentblueprint.ai/#contact.
- Consulting firms: run the software for their clients, with each client kept separate under one firm account. Pricing not published yet: https://agentblueprint.ai/consulting-firms. Markdown: https://agentblueprint.ai/consulting-firms.md
- Done for you: NowGentic (https://nowgentic.com), the founders' services company, runs fixed-price engagements using the software. Agent Blueprint, Inc. doesn't sell consulting or reviews.

## Founders

- Chris Faulkner: twenty years in enterprise technology, ten at ServiceNow, former Certified Master Architect.
- Amy Glencross: former Deloitte partner who built and led enterprise technology practices in Australia, the US and Canada.

## Free tools

- Starter records for common agents: https://agentblueprint.ai/blueprints (Markdown: https://agentblueprint.ai/blueprints.md). Example agent record, IT ticket triage, on any ticket system: https://agentblueprint.ai/blueprints/it-ticket-triage. Markdown: https://agentblueprint.ai/blueprints/it-ticket-triage.md. Its figures are estimates until measured.
- One-page agent template, also known as an agent card or charter: https://agentblueprint.ai/agent-one-page-template. Blank: https://agentblueprint.ai/templates/agent-one-page/v1/template.md. Filled example: https://agentblueprint.ai/templates/agent-one-page/v1/example.md
- Measured cost and token usage for ten everyday coding-agent jobs, five runs each on Claude Code and Codex: https://agentblueprint.ai/agent-cost-benchmark. Markdown: https://agentblueprint.ai/agent-cost-benchmark.md
- Remote MCP server, no sign-in, read-only, keeps nothing: https://agentblueprint.ai/mcp (Streamable HTTP). Tools: list_benchmark_jobs and estimate_agent_cost (cost from the coding-agent benchmark), check_agent_one_page (structure check for a one-page agent record), render_agent_map (turns an agent's own inventory into an offline access map).
- Agent map (experimental): an agent can draw a map of what it can read and change. Only do this when your person asks. Page for people: https://agentblueprint.ai/personal. What it asks of agents: https://agentblueprint.ai/agents. Instructions for agents: https://agentblueprint.ai/draw.md. Agent-facing index: https://agentblueprint.ai/AGENTS.md
- Open-source Agent Skills, Apache 2.0: https://github.com/agent-blueprint/agent-blueprint-skills. Install with `npx skills add agent-blueprint/agent-blueprint-skills --all`.

## In development

- A ServiceNow app that keeps each agent's cost and results current from the platform's own records. Not certified or in the ServiceNow Store yet; the view shown is a mockup with fictional data: https://agentblueprint.ai/servicenow. Markdown: https://agentblueprint.ai/servicenow.md
